title: Waymo's robotaxis are headed to Canada | TechCrunch
summary: Waymo tends to follow the same playbook for every new city, gradually proceeding from manual mapping to testing, and eventually operating a commercial service. The company’s co-CEO Tekedra Mawakana said the expansion into Canada marks an important milestone in its global journey.
